items.summary: Enable end-to-end sparse-conv model configs (SpUNet/OACNN/PointGroup) on ROCm via the spconv-triton drop-in, now that spconv is dispositioned already-supported. Upstream Pointcept imports spconv unguarded in those configs; spconv-triton (Apache-2.0, PyPI, MI300X-verified upstream, gfx90a/gfx1100 unverified) claims drop-in compatibility with spconv 2.x via a one-line import. Scope: wire the swap, then validate the sparse-conv configs end-to-end on real AMD GPUs.

decided.note: Start Pointcept's porter flow now that depends_on is satisfied -- spconv declined already-supported with spconv-triton as the route (in-session, 2026-08-20).
